profile.headline: Software engineer at IBM Watson
profile.summary:
Technical writer with superior technical skills. I enjoy getting my hands dirty with new technologies and digging deeply into products I'm documenting. I'm also concerned with product and documentation usability; product and documentation testing, both on my own and in collaboration with others, is a key part of all of my work.

Specialties: Technical writing for enterprise software and hardware, SGML/XML, most notably DocBook and DITA; XSLT/XSL-FO; documentation tools infrastructures; product usability; Python, Perl, UNIX shell, and other scripting languages; UNIX system administration; networked storage; project/team leadership
